prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-body transparent visual-novel NEUTRAL sprite of Paimon from Genshin Impact.
Input roles: Image 1 is the official complete-body portrait and PRIMARY authority for costume construction and anatomy. Images 2–5 are additional official artwork supplied by the user, supporting identity, face, hair, halo, cape design and colours. All five are official-art references; no generated sprite is an input. Ignore any companions, food, flower or other held prop in those references.
Body category: custom tiny floating companion, distinctly smaller than the small female body type. Keep Paimon's own compact childlike proportions, roughly 3–3.5 heads from hair crown to boot soles, excluding the halo. Large rounded head, short compact torso and short limbs; no adult or teenage elongation. At a common scene scale her body should read around two-thirds to three-quarters the height of a small female character. A tightly framed individual PNG must retain these tiny-body proportions.
Identity: white bobbed hair, dark four-point star hair ornament, blue-violet eyes, floating peach-gold halo, white outfit with peach-gold ornaments and cuffs, navy scarf and star-patterned split cape, matching white boots. Preserve the official chest emblem cleanly. The halo and starry cape are actual costume elements and must remain.
Neutral acting: cheerful, curious and companionable without a big excited expression. A small relaxed closed-mouth smile, both eyes open, gentle head tilt. Hover upright in midair, feet dangling freely with the knees slightly relaxed and the two legs clearly separated; no standing or ground contact. Let her arms float lightly at her sides with elbows slightly bent and hands relaxed near the waist, palms at a shallow readable angle. A gentle asymmetry conveys buoyancy, while her full silhouette stays easy to read. No prop in either hand.
Anatomy: one coherent torso and pelvis, exactly two arms, two legs and two feet. Each hand has one thumb on the correct anatomical side and four fingers joined to one palm and wrist. Use simple relaxed gestures close to the body, nearly in the image plane, with a clear palm orientation. Avoid extreme hand foreshortening, tangled fingers, elaborate splaying, or forcing hidden fingers into view. Keep the mouth a single simple natural shape. Preserve normal iris colours and ordinary pupils.
Composition: one complete centered full-body figure on a portrait canvas, with all hair, headwear, hands, costume tails, accessories and shoes visible. Aim for 92–96% visible height with roughly 2–4% transparent top and bottom padding; do not stretch anatomy to fill the canvas.
Finish: polished Genshin-style anime character illustration, delicate clean linework, soft dimensional cel shading, clear costume detailing and clean edges. TRUE alpha transparency. No scenery, labels, text, watermark, weapons, extra characters, floating decorative effects or ground shadow. Generate a fresh illustration from official art alone, not a recolour or repair of an earlier sprite.
